feature: 借扇成蝶 · 侧翼排练

adopted.opening:
晚场还没开，侧翼的灯先亮了。
排练单上写着：今晚先试一段扇影。
adopted.finale: 蝶影留在幕上，今晚这段排练成了。

composition: The third-act sentence and finale are shown together on the existing complete screen, while the view awaits the player's final lamp input. Touch-only action reminders remain separate from the narrative sentences.

retainedOperationInstructions.touch: 手机横过来：点选并拖动道具，点灯试演；按住道具观察。双指轻触撤回，双指按住打开排练单，里面可以重排、暂停或返回。
retainedOperationInstructions.keyboard: 键盘：Tab 换一件，方向键 / WASD 移动；Enter 试演，Z 撤回，R 重排，Esc 暂停。

failureFeedback.reason: The current mismatch checks projected radius and center, rather than whether a corner extends beyond the screen boundary.

presentationRevision.description: The common target and projected wing profile has distinct upper/lower lobes; projected silhouettes are clipped to the gauze. The earned final image adds a small body and antennae. Input, center/radius/side, levels, model and session remain unchanged.
